# authwise_appearance_profiles (Data Source)

An issuer's appearance profile: the stylesheet and content its login pages use. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `appearance_profiles` (Attributes List) Every appearance_profile under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appearance_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--appearance_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appearance_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `stylesheet_attributes` (String)
- `theme_id` (String)
